items.name: The Family Bundle
items.description:
Choose any four entrées from a selection of fresh salads, wraps, and melts—perfect for feeding a group. Need an option for the little ones? Swap any entrée for a Kids Meal. You can also complete your meal by upgrading with a quart of soup.
Available for online order ahead and delivery only.

items.name: Kids Bento Box
items.description: Building your own meal can be as fun as eating it! You get to choose one item from each of our 5 yummy categories (Proteins/Veggies/Fruits/Grains/Dressings).  All Kids Works menu items are served with a Juice Box.
